title: (LEAD) Check-in system at Incheon airport restored after hourslong disruption
caption:
A technical glitch in the ARINC network caused significant travel delays at Incheon International Airport today. 1,200 passengers were impacted before systems were restored.

Source: En - (LEAD) Check-in system at Incheon airport restored after hourslong disruption
